# Catholic Charities of Maine

> > Catholic Charities of Maine provides comprehensive social services across Maine including refugee resettlement, substance use disorder treatment, child development centers, food assistance, and behavioral health support.

Catholic Charities Maine operates programs throughout the state with major locations in Portland, Aroostook County, and the Kennebec Valley. The organization serves diverse populations including refugees, children, individuals in recovery, and those experiencing poverty through direct services, volunteer opportunities, and community partnerships.

## Key Topics

- Refugee and Immigration Services
- Substance Use Disorder Treatment and Recovery
- Child Development Centers and Childcare
- Food Security and FARM for ME
- Behavioral Health Services
- Volunteer Opportunities

- Walk for Recovery

- Portland Maine

- Community Support Programs

## Core Programs and Services

- [St. Elizabeth's Child Development Center :: Portland, Maine](https://www.ccmaine.org/st-elizabeths): St. Elizabeth's 5-star daycare center for ages 12 months to 5 years
- [St. Elizabth's Child Development Center ::  Daycare in Portland, Maine](https://www.ccmaine.org/st-elizabeths/about): About St. Elizabeth's daycare center in Portland, Cumberland County
- [FARM for ME](https://www.ccmaine.org/food-bank/farmforme/video): FARM for ME program growing fresh produce in Aroostook County
- [Walk for Recovery](https://www.ccmaine.org/support-recovery/walk-for-recovery): Annual Walk for Recovery fundraising event in Portland, Maine
- [Volunteer](https://www.ccmaine.org/volunteer): Main volunteer opportunities page for Catholic Charities Maine programs
- [About Employment](https://www.ccmaine.org/employment/about): Employment benefits and career opportunities at Catholic Charities Maine

## Refugee and Immigration Services

- [Catholic Charities Maine Refugee Immigration Services,  :: New Mainer Stories](https://www.ccmaine.org/refugee-immigration-services/stories-among-us-behzad-habibzai): Behzad Habibzai's refugee story from Kabul, Afghanistan to Portland
- [Support and Volunteering](https://www.ccmaine.org/refugee-immigration-services/faqs/support-and-volunteering): Refugee Immigration Services volunteer FAQs and support information
- [RHP Form](https://www.ccmaine.org/omrs/resources/rhp-form): Resettlement Housing Placement form for OMRS refugee services

## Substance Use Disorder and Recovery

- [Substance Abuse Support Services :: Inspiration & Recovery](https://www.ccmaine.org/substance-use-disorder-treatment/inspiration-recovery): Recovery stories featuring Melissa, Dan, and Narcan awareness testimonials
- [News - Substance Abuse](https://www.ccmaine.org/substance-abuse-support/news): Substance abuse support services news and updates from Maine
